Comment by mike-loux-planview: Seeing this as well. I can type in the search box and click on the hamburger menu, but the min/max/close buttons do not work, nor can I drag the window around. Interestingly enough, resizing the window returns control to the above, and I am then able to close it via the X. 🤔 Note - I just updated t v0.99 this AM and have other issues (e.g. Command Palette being basically useless), but I see those are being reported, so I will leave it to them. EDIT #2 - The main window also becomes unresponsive when trying to access the Command Palette via the Quick Shortcut. Actually, no, wait. It becomes unresponsive just by opening it from the system tray. But the resize hack definitely works. Hopefully that helps somebody suss it out.
